an9.37:1.1: evaṃ me sutaṃ ekaṃ: samayaṃ āyasmā ānando kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
an9.37:1.2: tatra kho āyasmā ānando bhikkhu āmantesi.
an9.37:1.4: āvusoti kho te bhikkhu āyasmato ānandassa paccassosuṃ.
an9.37:2.2: yāvañcidaṃ tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammā sambuddhena sambādho okāsādhigamo anubuddho sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokapariddavānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya.
an9.37:2.3: tadeva nāma cakkhuṃ bhavissati te rūpā tañcāyatanaṃ no paṭisaṃvedissati.
an9.37:2.4: tadeva nāma sotaṃ bhavissati, te saddā, tañcāyatanaṃ no paṭisaṃvedissati.
an9.37:2.5: tadeva nāma ghānaṃ bhavissati, te gandhā. tañcāyatanaṃ, no paṭisaṃvedissati.
an9.37:2.6: sā ca nāma jivhā bhavissati, te rasā. tañcāyatanaṃ no paṭisaṃvedissati,
an9.37:2.7: so ca nāma kāyo bhavissati te phoṭṭhabbā tañcāyatanaṃ no paṭisaṃvedissatīti.
an9.37:3.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā udāyī āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca:
an9.37:3.2: “saññīmeva nukho āvuso ānanda tadāyatanaṃ no paṭisaṃvedeti udāhu asaññī”ti?
an9.37:3.3: saññīmeva kho āvuso tadāyatanaṃ no paṭisaṃvedeti. no asaññīti.
an9.37:4.1: kiṃ saññī panāvuso tadāyatanaṃ no paṭisaṃvedetīti?
an9.37:4.2: idhāvuso bhikkhu sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ‘ananto ākāso’ti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an9.37:4.3: evaṃ saññīpi kho āvuso tadāyatanaṃ no paṭisaṃvedeti.
an9.37:5.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhu sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘anantaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an9.37:5.2: evaṃ saññīpi kho āvuso tadāyatanaṃ no paṭisaṃvedeti.
an9.37:6.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso, bhikkhu sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma natthi kiñcī’ti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an9.37:6.2: evaṃ saññīpi kho āvuso tadāyatanaṃ no paṭisaṃvedetīti.
an9.37:7.1: ekamidāhaṃ āvuso, samayaṃ sākete viharāmi añjanavane migadāye.
an9.37:7.2: atha kho āvuso, jaṭilagāhiyā bhikkhunī yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho āvuso, jaṭilabhāgiyā bhikkhunī maṃ etadavoca:
an9.37:7.3: “yāyaṃ bhante ānanda samādhi nacābhinato na cāpanato na ca sasaṅkhāra niggayha vāritavate”
an9.37:7.4: vimuttattā ṭhito, ṭhitattā santusito santusitattā no paritassati.
an9.37:7.5: ayaṃ bhante ānanda samādhi kiṃphalo vutto bhagavatāti?
an9.37:8.1: evaṃ vutte ahaṃ āvuso jaṭilagāhiyaṃ bhikkhuniṃ etadavocaṃ:
an9.37:8.2: yāyaṃ bhagini samādhi na cābhinato na cāpanato, na sasaṅkhāraniggayha vāritavato,
an9.37:8.3: vimuttattā ṭhito, ṭhitattā santusito, santusitattā no paritassati.
an9.37:8.4: ayaṃ bhagini samādhi aññāphalo vutto bhagavatāti.
an9.37:8.5: evaṃ saññīpi kho āvuso tadāyatanaṃ no paṭisaṃvedeti.
